title: CP4C input configuration domain readback and side-switch integration
preserved_behaviors: Preserve WD-002 owner-verified Windows-initiated mode switch behavior: UI must not bounce back to the previous mode before settling on the requested mode.
Preserve keyboard-initiated mode-switch follow behavior as currently shipped; speed improvement is explicitly deferred outside WD-003.

Preserve legacy firmware behavior when CP4C catalog key is absent or not allowlisted: ordinary keys use existing local Windows config display and existing 0x73/0x04 save flow; side-switch shows traditional Auto/Manual facts without editable 0x97 form.
Preserve existing Shortcut and Macro editor semantics; WD-003 may reuse them for side-switch Custom Shortcut/Macro but must not simplify or fork their meaning.

Preserve existing light, OLED/GIF/image, voice, mode, power, BLE connection, USB HID transport, Restore Factory, CP5, firmware upgrade/recovery and HID descriptor behavior unless directly required by the approved input-domain contract.
